scope: Same matched fixture: 60 cases x 3 questions. Qwen/Harrier embedding export uses real MLX/Metal; generic typed scoring is CPU NumPy, not GPU-resident. Laya inference MLX/Metal; JEV remote HTTP.

runtime.device_and_work: Apple Silicon. Exporter embed_text calls MLX eval synchronously, then as_slice::<f32>() copies vectors to host; JSON parse/serialization and export file IO are CPU. Probe scorer is CPU NumPy. Laya device is GPU per saved metadata. JEV timing includes remote network/service; compute opaque.

feature_reuse.state_reuse: No standalone state vector: full state is included in each question query, so it is re-encoded three times per case.
feature_reuse.candidate_text_deduplication: None; each row query and candidate are separate embedding calls.

real_mlx_export_process.scope: Fresh subprocess wall: process startup + model load/init + 714 synchronous embedding eval/copies + input parse + CPU JSONL+manifest export. Model load/warmup not separately instrumented.
real_mlx_export_process.warmup: No explicit warmup. OS/device cache state uncontrolled; model load/init not split.
real_mlx_export_process.synchronization_provenance: crates/decengine-engine-mlx/src/lib.rs:60-72 embed_text calls embedding.eval() then copies as_slice::<f32>() before returning; exporter loops serially over query and each candidate.

saved_numpy_frozen_scorer_per_question.scope: numpy frozen-scorer only; excludes MLX export, file IO, feature parsing, reference scoring

input_text_tokens.padding: None; independent variable-length inputs, causal triangular attention.

qwen.formula: Per independent text length n: L*[n*(4H^2+4H*Hkv+6H*I) + 4H*n(n+1)/2]. 1 MAC=2 FLOPs; includes Q/K/V/O projections, gated MLP, full causal QK and AV. Sum query and all candidate strings per question/case.
qwen.omissions: No learned projection head is specified in verified config; last-token pooling and L2 normalization O(H) per text omitted. Excludes embedding lookup, norm, RoPE, activation, softmax, other lower-order ops; no quantization/sparsity discount. Arithmetic estimate, not GPU counters.

numpy_classifier_arithmetic_estimate.stages_per_candidate: pair feature concat values: q*c multiply + q-c subtract + abs (3*1024 ops); standardization subtract/divide 2*4096; dot product approx 2*4096 FLOPs. Softmax nonlinear/reductions not counted. Pair-feature construction occurs before saved scorer timer; rest CPU NumPy, not GPU.

comparability.reason: That estimate is from a different 300-case fixture and three separate full Laya decision calls. The pairwise probes embed one query plus 2-5 candidate texts/question. Operations/work differ; no like-for-like FLOP ratio is defensible. This matched Laya run has timings but no matched-case FLOP breakdown.

limitations: Only one cold process timing per embedder; cannot report exporter per-case or p50/p95. Model load and initialization are included but not isolated.
No per-embedding timestamps were emitted; no extra instrumentation/source changes. Per-text eval is synchronized before the host vector copy.
Saved probe scorer p50/p95 are NumPy-only and exclude embedding, feature parsing, pair feature creation, file IO, and labeling.
FLOPs are arithmetic estimates from pinned configs and exact unpadded token lengths, not measured hardware operations; omit lower-order operations as detailed below.
The timed exports are fresh single subprocesses, but OS/device cache state is not controlled; timing is a one-run observation, not a repeatable percentile.
